perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=incremental below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The advertised matched all-test r^{-1/4} frontier is not fully proved: Lemma 2 reduces its load-bearing uniform shifted-support bound to an undisplayed cancellation and an assertion that unspecified polynomial coefficients are nonnegative. The exact K3 and C4 values likewise rest on a narrative CAD procedure and a claimed terminal sign table rather than supplied, independently checkable certificates. What is securely delivered is unbiased quadratic estimation, attainment and duality of the finite variance game, calibration by exhaustive semialgebraic enumeration in principle, and an upper detection rate for disjoint repeated motifs—not the claimed matched minimax frontier. The restrictive repeated-motif model and absence of executable calibration or certificate evidence further constrain the leading-journal score. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: shifted_support_bound_not_discharged@lem:hard-subexperiment-affinity, qe_upper_certificate_missing@prop:two-motif-constants, related_work_omission@thm:quadratic-frontier
